notes:
I found three places a family can walk into with a preschooler. I couldn't search further (I ran out of searches), so I read the hours off each venue's own page and haven't checked the Brooklyn Children's Museum. Those pages show 2026 hours and don't yet show next September's schedule. If this visit is September 2027, check each venue's hours page before you go.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Children's Museum of Manhattan (CMOM), 212 West 83rd Street",
      "age_fit": "children ages 0-6",
      "when": "Tuesday-Sunday, 10am-5pm; daily Circle Time 10:30am and Messy with Art in the afternoon",
      "source_name": "Children's Museum of Manhattan"
    },
    {
      "name": "Central Park Zoo (includes Tisch Children's Zoo)",
      "age_fit": "Child (3-12) $16.95; Child (2 & under) free",
      "when": "Mon-Fri 10:00am-5:00pm, weekends 10:00am-5:30pm; penguin feeding 10:40am and 2:30pm, sea lion feeding 11:30am and 3:30pm",
      "price": "Child (3-12) $16.95; adult $22.95",
      "source_name": "Central Park Zoo (Wildlife Conservation Society)"
    },
    {
      "name": "New York Aquarium, Coney Island",
      "age_fit": "Child (3-12); Child (2 & Under) free",
      "when": "Daily 10:00am-5:00pm, September 8 to October 31, 2026; last entry 4:00pm",
      "price": "Child (3-12) $25.95 off-peak, $27.95 peak",
      "source_name": "New York Aquarium (Wildlife Conservation Society)"
    }
  ]
}
```

Things to know before you go:
- **CMOM:** Its pages disagree on Mondays. The current Plan Your Visit page says Tuesday-Sunday. An older visitor-guidelines page says July-September is open Monday-Sunday. If you land on a Monday, check before you go. I found no current price on its own pages, so I left it out.
- **Central Park Zoo:** Its FAQ says same-day tickets can be bought online, and kiosk and window sales depend on availability. The $16.95 child price comes from an older copy of its page.
- **New York Aquarium:** Its Wednesday free-admission window starts at 3pm and needs advance timed tickets. One listing says tickets open the Monday before at 3pm. That fact comes from a listing site, not the aquarium's own pages.
